shivprime94-file-itr-itr-india.description: Assist a resident Indian individual with preparing and e-filing an Income Tax Return (ITR-1/2/3/4) on the e-filing portal (eportal.incometax.gov.in), under EITHER the old or new tax regime (non-resident / RNOR returns are out of scope). Use WHENEVER the user mentions filing taxes in India, ITR, income tax return, 26AS, AIS, Form 16, employment history, job change, multiple employers, old vs new regime, 115BAC, Form 10-IEA, 80C/80D/HRA/home-loan/NPS/80G deductions, 44ADA/44AD presumptive, self-assessment/advance tax/234B/234C, TDS reconciliation, capital gains on Indian shares/mutual…
